meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: 它先自己在真实界面上做手动 QA，记录成证据表；再只派一个门禁评审子代理，对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全和是否漏掉上下文做审计。任一 QA 行失败或评审不通过，都判不合格。
howto.when: 在把改动交给别人之前（如准备发起 PR），或你明确要求复查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: 把我刚完成的改动做一次门禁复查。
say.note: 它会先做真实界面 QA，再派评审子代理。

say.text: 我准备发出 PR，先帮我复查这次改动。
say.note: 会核对目标、约束、代码质量和 QA 证据。

say.text: 这次是 API 改动，按门禁复查流程走一遍。
say.note: 会用 curl 记录响应作为 QA 证据。

howto.what_en: On request, it runs manual QA on the real surface, records a QA matrix, then launches one gate-reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, and missed context. Passes only if no QA row fails and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggered before handing work off (such as opening a PR) or when the user explicitly asks to review completed implementation.

say_en.text: Run the gate review on the change I just finished.
say_en.note: It runs real-surface QA first, then one reviewer.

say_en.text: I am about to open a PR; please gate-review this work first.
say_en.note: It checks goal, constraints, code quality, and QA evidence.

say_en.text: This change is only an API update; run the gate review on it.
say_en.note: It uses curl responses as QA evidence.
